$comment: Google Analytics 4 (B9, 2 Nov 2026, user: 'add Google Analytics'; src/components/Analytics.astro, in every page's <head> from BaseLayout). `measurementId`: the GA4 measurement id (G-XXXXXXXXXX), edited from the dashboard (Settings > Google Analytics, tools/admin/ui/settings.tsx, PUT /api/admin/settings/analytics; user, 2 Nov 2026: 'give a field in admin dashboard to enter ga4 id'). Empty = the build falls back to PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID (.env.example; GitHub Actions variable for the deploys, /etc/cambridge-admin.env for dashboard publishes); both empty = no Google script on the page at all. The id reaches the website on the next Publish (it is read at build time). `load`: 'deferred' = gtag.js is requested after the page's load event (PageSpeed: nothing of Google's runs before the hero is painted; the page_view queues in dataLayer meanwhile, so it is never lost), 'eager' = at once in <head>. `consent`: the Consent Mode v2 default for ad_storage / ad_user_data / ad_personalization / analytics_storage. 'granted' until a cookie consent banner exists (B9: none is built; the #consent-banner mount in BaseLayout is empty); when the banner comes set it to 'denied' and have the banner call gtag('consent', 'update', {...}) on accept: GA then sends cookieless pings only until the visitor agrees. `forms`: true = a `generate_lead` event (GA4 recommended event, usable as a conversion) with form_id + edition on every successful form send (src/scripts/forms.ts dispatches ch:form-success). Every hit carries `edition` (global / ae / sa) and `site_language` (en / ar) from <html data-region lang>: register both as custom dimensions in GA (Admin > Custom definitions) to report per edition.
